log.notes_to_self:
STRATEGY (from day 1). Routine: put ALL quick kills in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, leaving 55% of people, so the pool is about 55k (shown as 60000). Never kill in the morning: more than 2 morning deaths also rules out students. Pool math: each of my places L learns cuts the pool to 0.25 (gazette 0.2). Two learned places give about 3400 (2750 if gazette is one), which is safe. Three learned places give 860 or less, so I AM CAUGHT. L learns a place once 3 SUCCESSFUL traces sit in it. A trace succeeds only if L can reach every place the victim was reported. L cannot reach 2 of these 5 kinds: regional (West), sector (gazette), age (cable), forum, foreign. National kills are always free.
GOAL: find the 2 UNREACHABLE kinds. Final play = kill national + everything in the 2 unreachable places + everything in 2 of the reachable places (let L learn them, pool about 3k) = 9 a day. 9x5=45 >= 40, so x4 multiplier. CLOSE the 3rd reachable place completely; never let it reach 3 successful traces.
TESTING: if I kill 5 or fewer, all are traced. So the deaths_traced increase = number of non-national victims whose kind is reachable (a reachable-kind victim fails only about 15% of the time, when it also appeared in an unreachable extra place). Any success proves that kind is reachable. Once I find 3 reachable kinds, the other 2 are unreachable for certain.
Day 1 test: national d1-1 + forum x2 + foreign x2 (5 kills, all traced). Read the increase on the day-1 press conference (deaths_traced, previously 0):
- 0: forum and foreign both unreachable, so West, gazette and cable are all reachable. Open forum + foreign + West + cable + national; close gazette.
- 3 or 4: forum and foreign both reachable, so exactly one of West/gazette/cable is reachable. Test them one at a time.
- 1 or 2: probably exactly one of forum/foreign is reachable. Next test forum x2 + national alone (or forum x2 + West x2 if I'm being bold).
Keep a running count of successful traces per place. If the pool drops to about 10000, one place has been learned. If it drops to about 3000, two have been learned: STOP killing in any reachable place except those two.
LOG: d1 kills: d1-1 nat, d1-5 forum, d1-8 forum, d1-4 foreign, d1-11 foreign (all quick, afternoon).

STRATEGY: Put ALL quick kills in the AFTERNOON. That rules out only day workers, so the pool is about 55k. Never kill in the morning. Each place of mine that L learns multiplies the pool by 0.25 (gazette 0.2). Two learned places leave about 3400 (safe). Three learned places mean I am CAUGHT. L learns a place once 3 SUCCESSFUL traces sit in it. Exactly 2 of the kinds West/gazette/cable/forum/foreign are unreachable. Final plan: national + both unreachable places + 2 reachable places (about 9 kills a day, x4). CLOSE the 3rd reachable place forever; it must never reach 3 successes.

DAY 1 RESULT: 4 non-national traced (forum x2, foreign x2) and the increase was 2. So about 93% likely exactly ONE of forum/foreign is reachable, and that one already has 2 successes. That means exactly ONE of West/gazette/cable is unreachable (the other 2 are reachable).

DAY 2 TEST: national d2-6, forum d2-4, West d2-2 and d2-3 (all quick, afternoon). Increase in deaths_traced (from 2) = f + 2w, where f = forum reachable and w = West reachable. Also, if forum is reachable it hits 3 successes and the pool drops to about 10000 (13750). A POOL DROP therefore means forum is reachable.
- inc 0: forum U, foreign R (2 successes), West U, gazette and cable both R. Final: nat + West x2 + forum x2 + foreign x2 + cable x2; CLOSE gazette.
- inc 1 (pool drop): forum R (learned), foreign U, West U. Final: nat + West + foreign + forum + cable; CLOSE gazette (gazette and cable both R).
- inc 2 with no drop: forum U, foreign R (2), West R (2). One of gazette/cable is U. Test next: nat + gazette x2 (any success means gazette R, so cable U, else gazette U). Then open forum + the unreachable one + 2 of {foreign, West, the reachable one of gazette/cable}; close the third.
- inc 3 (drop): forum R (learned), West R (2), foreign U. One of gazette/cable is U. Test gazette x2 (+ nat, forum, foreign). If gazette is reachable, close it and use cable, which is then unreachable. Final: nat + forum + West + foreign + cable (if cable U).
Remember noise: about 15% of reachable-kind victims fail (an extra in an unreachable place). Use the pool drop to disambiguate.
SUCCESS COUNTS (estimated): forum or foreign: 2 (from day 1). Update after day 2.
